name: @w6w-apps/contentful
description: Read and manage Contentful spaces, content types, entries, assets and locales.

w6w.longDescription:
Contentful reads and writes structured content from a workflow — listing and fetching entries, creating and updating them, and reading the content types that define their shape, so a workflow can adapt to a space's schema instead of assuming a fixed set of fields.

Assets and locales are available too: assets can be listed and fetched for use alongside the entries that reference them, and locales can be listed to handle a space that publishes in more than one language correctly rather than assuming a single default.

Useful for keeping Contentful in sync with another system — publishing a new entry when content is approved elsewhere, updating one as source data changes, or pulling entries and their assets into another step of a workflow for further processing or distribution.
